leakPathDiagram.description: Current seed leak paths in MoneroWallet.ts

dataFlow: Returns { address, mnemonic } via JSI bridge
Line 48: extracts result.mnemonic → assigns to WalletInfo.seed
Returns WalletInfo { address, seed, restoreHeight } to JS caller
Seed now exists as JavaScript string in heap
JS caller passes seed string (from backup entry, clipboard, etc.)
createWalletFromSeed receives seed as string parameter
Seed crosses JSI bridge into native memory
Native code derives keys from mnemonic
Seed parameter already in JS scope
Function returns same seed in WalletInfo object
Caller receives seed again - redundant exposure

downstreamConsumers.impact: Exports leaky API to all consumers
Customer app can import and use leaky wallet
Runner app can import and use leaky wallet

proposedNativeApi.principle: No wallet secret (seed, spendKey, privateViewKey, PIN) ever crosses into JavaScript/JSI as managed value
